operations.title: Get Blocked Malicious URL Events
operations.description: Retrieves events associated with clicks to malicious URLs that were blocked on Proofpoint TAP within the specified time period and other input parameters such as threat status, threat type, etc.

parameters.title: Time Interval
parameters.name: interval

Seconds.title: Since Seconds
Seconds.name: sinceSeconds
Seconds.description: Since Seconds representing a time window in seconds from the current Proofpoint TAP server time.

Time.title: Since Time
Time.name: sinceTime
Time.description: Since Time represents the start of the data retrieval period from Proofpoint TAP server.

parameters.description:
Time period for which you want to fetch events associated with clicks to malicious URLs that were blocked on Proofpoint TAP. You can choose between Seconds or Time.

If you choose Seconds, then in the Since Seconds field, specify the time window in seconds from when you want to fetch events associated with clicks to malicious URLs that were blocked on Proofpoint TAP.
If you choose Time, then in the Since TIme field, specify the time window from when you want to fetch events associated with clicks to malicious URLs that were blocked on Proofpoint TAP.

parameters.title: Format
parameters.name: format
parameters.description: (Optional) Format in whichyou want to fetch events associated with clicks to malicious URLs that were blocked on Proofpoint TAP. You can choose between JSON or Syslog.

parameters.title: Threat Type
parameters.name: threat_type
parameters.description: (Optional) Type of threats based on which you want to fetch events associated with clicks to malicious URLs that were blocked on Proofpoint TAP. You can choose URL, Attachments, Message Text, or a combination of these threat types.

parameters.title: Threat Status
parameters.name: threat_status
parameters.description: (Optional) Status of threats based on which you want to fetch events associated with clicks to malicious URLs that were blocked on Proofpoint TAP. You can choose Active, Cleared, False Positive, or a combination of these threat types.

Seconds.description: Since Seconds representing a time window in seconds from the current Proofpoint TAP server time. Since seconds values, minimum is thirty and maximum is 3600(one hour).

Time.title: Since Time
Time.name: sinceTime

Time.description: Since Time represents the start of the data retrieval period from Proofpoint TAP server. Note: Since time should not be more than 1 hour of Proofpoint TAP server time.

operations.title: Get Campaign Details
operations.description: Retrieves details of a campaign from Proofpoint TAP based on the campaign ID specified.

parameters.title: Campaign ID
parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: ID of the campaign whose details you want to retrieve from Proofpoint TAP.

operations.title: Get Forensic Details
operations.description: Retrieves forensic details of a campaign from Proofpoint TAP based on the threat or campaign ID specified.

parameters.title: ID Type
parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Type of ID whose forensic detailsyou want to retrieve from Proofpoint TAP. You can choose between Campaign ID or Threat ID.

parameters.title: Value
parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value of the campaign ID or threat ID whose forensic detailsyou want to retrieve from Proofpoint TAP.

parameters.title: Include Campaign Forensics
parameters.name: include_campaign_forensics
parameters.description: Select this option to include campaign forensics in the details thatyou want to retrieve from Proofpoint TAP.
